Safety First

Your safety matters

Help Her Out is designed with safety at its core. We provide tools to help you connect safely—but no platform can guarantee safety. Use your judgment always.

For Taskers

1. Review Before You Accept

Check the task photos to understand the job. Review the client's verification badges, completed task count, and what others say about working with them.

2. First Visit? Bring a Buddy

For your first time with a client, join as a lead tasker or safety buddy. Two people make the visit safer for everyone.

3. Share Your Appointment

When you accept a task, share the details with a trusted contact—location, time, client name, and expected duration.

4. Use Check-In

Tell Help Her Out when you're heading to the task, when you've arrived, and when you're done. If something feels wrong, press "Leave Now" immediately.

5. Trust Your Instincts

If the job or person feels different than expected, you can leave. You don't owe anyone your time or safety. Report concerns to help other women stay safe.

For Clients

1. Be Clear & Honest

Describe the task honestly. Include photos of the work area. If something's physically demanding, say so. If the job is different in person, acknowledge it respectfully.

2. Protect Your Privacy

Don't share your exact address until the task is accepted. Use general neighborhood descriptions. The task details are only fully visible after matching.

3. Verify Taskers

Check tasker verification badges and reviews. Ask questions. Communication before the task starts prevents misunderstandings.

4. Have a Backup

Make sure someone knows taskers are coming. Be home or arrange someone to be home. Use the buddy system for your first time hiring.

5. Report Problems

If a tasker behaves unsafely or inappropriately, report it immediately. Your feedback helps Help Her Out stay safe for everyone.

Emergency

If you are in immediate danger, call 911. No app feature replaces emergency services.

Our Commitment

Help Her Out is committed to building an infrastructure of trust:

✓ Identity verification through third-party services
✓ Verified reviews and ratings
✓ Buddy system for first visits
✓ Easy reporting and blocking
✓ Privacy-first design

We can't guarantee safety, but we can create a community where women help women safely.
